full_prompt_en: A square retro cartoon illustration shows two small boys sitting face to face on low stools in a crowded mechanical workshop. The background is dominated by an immense pale circular mechanism centered high behind them. Rings, spokes, dials, and fine technical marks radiate outward from it, while shelves and clustered devices fill the left and right walls. The palette is nearly monochrome, mixing warm cream highlights with faded blue-gray and charcoal linework. In the middle ground, the boy on the left has spiky black hair and wears a dark short-sleeved outfit. He faces right in profile, with a large simple eye, small nose, and open hand raised toward his companion. The boy on the right wears a blue cap, matching jacket, and trousers. He faces left with a similarly rounded childlike face, one hand lifted in reply and the other near his lap. Their oversized heads and short bodies make them the clearest shapes amid the intricate workshop. Both sit on plain dark wooden stools; their legs and black shoes form a mirrored arrangement above the plank floor. A small wheeled metal object sits near the lower-right corner, and scattered papers lie across the lower center. Dense pipes, gauges, and boxy forms crowd the side edges but fade into lighter detail around the central round device. Warm light glows from the center rear, creating a halo between the two faces and long soft shadows beneath the stools toward the foreground. Fine pencil-like hatching and worn paper grain give the scene an aged storybook surface. No readable writing can be distinguished on the scattered pages or equipment. The overall composition is friendly and curious, balancing simple expressive characters against a complex radial world of invention.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形复古卡通插画呈现两个小男孩在机械装置拥挤的工坊中，坐在低凳上面对面交谈。背景由两人身后高处一座巨大的浅色圆形机构主导。环形、轮辐、仪表和细密技术线痕从那里向外放射，架子与成簇设备填满左右墙面。配色接近单色，以暖乳色高光混合褪色蓝灰与炭黑线条。中景左侧男孩有尖尖黑发，穿深色短袖服装。他以侧面朝右，大而简洁的眼睛、小鼻子，以及向同伴举起的张开手清楚可见。右侧男孩戴蓝帽，穿同色外套与长裤。他朝左，脸同样圆润而带童稚感，一只手抬起回应，另一只靠近膝上。夸张的大头和短身体让他们成为繁复工坊里最清晰的形状。两人坐在朴素深色木凳上，腿和黑鞋在木板地面上方形成相互呼应的排列。一个带轮子的小金属物位于右下角，几页散纸铺在下部中央。密集管线、仪表与盒形装置挤在两侧画边，靠近中央圆形机构处则淡成较浅的细节。暖光从后方中央发出，在两张面孔之间形成光晕，并把凳下柔长阴影投向前景。细铅笔般排线和磨旧纸面颗粒赋予场景古老故事书的表面。散纸和设备上辨认不出可读文字。整体构图友好而充满好奇，以简洁富表情的角色平衡复杂的放射状发明世界。
style_prompt_en: The retro cartoon treatment sets extremely simple rounded focal silhouettes inside a richly packed field of fine mechanical-looking marks. Warm cream, faded slate-blue, and charcoal create a near-monochrome range with gentle old-paper warmth. Thin pencil-like lines, crosshatching, small circles, and worn grain build complexity around a clear open center. A large radial pattern gives the background order even when side areas are crowded with many details. Soft backlight brightens the center and lets dark foreground shapes stand out without harsh black-white separation. Proportions are playful and compact; expressive gestures are captured with a few confident curves. Repetition of circular and rectangular rhythms gives the busy texture coherence, while long floor shadows add scale. Edges remain clean on major forms and lightly abraded in the surroundings. The overall effect is inventive, nostalgic, and accessible, with simple graphic expression supported by patient technical texture.
style_prompt_zh: 这种复古卡通处理把极简圆润的焦点剪影放在细密而拥挤、带机械感的笔痕区域中。暖乳色、褪色石板蓝和炭黑构成近单色色域，并有温和的旧纸暖意。细铅笔般线条、交叉排线、小圆形与磨损颗粒围绕清楚开放的中央建立复杂度。一道大型放射图案使背景即使两侧塞满细节仍保持秩序。柔和逆光照亮中央，让深色前方形状突出，却没有生硬的黑白分割。比例俏皮且紧凑，富表情的姿态由少数自信曲线捕捉。圆形与矩形节奏的重复让繁忙肌理连贯，地面长影又增加尺度。主要形体边缘干净，周围则有轻微磨损。整体效果富于发明感、怀旧且亲切，简洁图形表现受到耐心技术肌理的支撑。
theme_en: Two small cartoon boys talking inside a crowded mechanical workshop
theme_zh: 两个卡通男孩在机械装置密布的工坊中交谈
name: Osamu Tezuka
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
